### English

- Set the default Blockout grid spacing to 0.5 metres and base color to a muted blue-grey #8A9BA8 so side faces separate from the dark top faces. Add a Top Roughness material property (default 0.8, also a project default) so top and bottom faces read matte while sides keep Roughness 0.3. Add a Default Blockout Material color picker to the dock, sized like the Inspector's color property; the project-wide color applies to newly created shapes without changing existing instances and is saved when the picker closes. Remove the dock's Default Box Size control and its project setting; new Boxes use the 1 x 1 x 1 m default.
- Fix Corner Curved Inner: it now keeps the solid at the origin corner and curves the face inward, instead of generating the complementary piece in the opposite corner. Footprint and volume are unchanged. Corner Curved Quality now defaults to 4 (eight arc segments) for a smoother curve.
- Restyle both READMEs with badges, quick-start steps, tables, collapsible handle notes and new screenshots of a sample level, every shape, handle positions, shape options, materials and the dock. Remove the outdated gallery image, and stop publishing the archived docs/gameplay sources.
- Add adjustable Grid Subdivisions to the material Inspector and project defaults. Minor grid spacing defaults to one fifth of Grid Size, without rebuilding geometry when changed.
- Set the default Grid Snap Ratio to 1.0 so shape handles follow the editor translation snap step directly; Ctrl toggle and Shift fine snapping remain available.
- Add a Box X/Z handle at the corner opposite the origin for simultaneous width/depth editing in the local XZ plane, keeping height, origin and existing axis handles unchanged. Support joint scene-grid snapping under rotation, centimetre rounding and complete cancel/undo/redo.
- Set the default Railing length to two metres with two one-metre spans. Move the Railing length handle to the far end and the elevation handle to the top of the interior post nearest the length midpoint (the end post for a single span), keeping whole-railing slope editing. Snap elevation at the far bottom edge so the middle handle moves proportionally instead of consuming the full grid step. Length drags retain full one-metre spans and grow only the last span, adding or removing posts as needed; keep legacy uniform layouts, grid snapping and complete parameter undo/redo. Add a Y-axis height handle with half-metre rail layers, a one-layer minimum and height-aware elevation handles; Closed panels resize with the posts. Add level-elevation and minimum-height snap targets so coarse or offset grids keep both stops reachable.

### 中文

- 默认 Blockout 网格间距改为 0.5 米，底色改为雾霾蓝 #8A9BA8，使侧面与深色顶面更易区分。材质新增 Top Roughness 属性（默认 0.8，也可设为项目默认值），顶面和底面更哑光，侧面保持 Roughness 0.3。面板新增 Default Blockout Material 颜色选择器，高度与 Inspector 的颜色属性一致；项目级颜色只用于新建形状，不覆盖已有实例，并在选择器关闭时保存。移除面板中的 Default Box Size 控件及其项目设置，新建 Box 使用 1 × 1 × 1 米默认尺寸。
- 修复 Corner Curved 的 Inner 选项：实体保留在原点一侧，弧面改为向内凹，不再在对角生成互补的那一块；占地范围和体积不变。Corner Curved Quality 默认值改为 4（弧线 8 段），曲面更平滑。
- 中英文 README 重新排版，加入徽章、快速开始步骤、表格、可折叠的手柄说明，以及示例关卡、全部形状、手柄位置、形状选项、材质和停靠面板的新截图。移除过时的展示图，归档的 docs/gameplay 源码不再上传。
- 材质 Inspector 和项目默认设置新增可调 Grid Subdivisions，细网格间距默认为 Grid Size 的五分之一，修改时无需重建几何。
- 默认 Grid Snap Ratio 改为 1.0，形状手柄直接跟随编辑器位移吸附步长，保留 Ctrl 切换及 Shift 精细吸附。
- Box 原点对顶角新增 X/Z 手柄，可在本地 XZ 平面内同时调整宽深，保持高度、原点和原单轴手柄不变；支持旋转后的双坐标场景网格吸附、厘米舍入及完整取消／撤销／重做。
- Railing 默认总长改为 2 米，由两跨各 1 米组成。长度手柄移至远端，斜度手柄移至最靠近长度中点的中间立柱顶端（单跨使用终点柱顶），拖动仍调节整段斜度。斜度吸附以远端底边为基准，中间手柄按距离比例移动，不再占用完整网格步长。长度拖动保留完整 1 米跨，只拉长最后一跨，并按需增减柱子；保留旧等距布局、网格吸附及完整参数撤销/重做。新增 Y 轴高度手柄，横杆按 0.5 米层距增减且最低保留一层，斜度手柄随柱高移动，Closed 面板随高度伸缩。水平与最小高度设独立吸附点，避免粗网格或网格偏移导致目标状态不可达。
